title: Z--Elevator Inspection and Certification Services
agency: INTERIOR, DEPARTMENT OF THE > BUREAU OF RECLAMATION > MP-REGIONAL OFFICE
description: Elevator Inspection and Certification Services  This is not a solicitation announcement. This is a Sources Sought Notice issued solely for market research and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Quote (RFQ), and it does not obligate the Government to award a contract. The Bureau of Reclamation, Interior Region 10, California Great Basin Region, Central California Area Office (CCAO), is seeking potential sources capable of providing independent elevator inspection and certification services for elevators located at Folsom Dam, Folsom Powerplant, and New Melones Powerplant in California. The Government is conducting market research to determine the availability of qualified firms and to assist in determining the appropriate acquisition strategy. The requirement is for Qualified Elevator Inspector (QEI) services to perform periodic elevator inspections, witness required testing, provide inspection reports, identify deficiencies and recommendations, and provide elevator certifications in accordance with applicable ASME requirements, including ASME A17.1, A17.2, A17.3, and QEI-1 standards.  The anticipated contract will consist of a base year and four option years. Inspection services are anticipated to include: - One annual Category 1 inspection for each of the three elevators (unless superseded by a Category 5 inspection). - One periodic six-month inspection for each of the three elevators. - Witnessing of Category 1 and Category 5 testing performed by the elevator maintenance contractor. - Preparation and submission of inspection reports and certification documentation.  The anticipated NAICS code for this requirement is 541350 ¿ Building Inspection Services (Size Standard: $11.5 Million).  Competition, set-aside decisions, and acquisition strategy may be based on the results of this market research.  Interested firms should submit a capability statement addressing their ability to meet the requirements described above. Responses should include: 1. Company name, address, and SAM Unique Entity ID (UEI). 2. Business size and socioeconomic status (e.g., Small Business, HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB, 8(a)). 3. Relevant experience performing independent elevator inspection and certification services for commercial, industrial, utility, hydroelectric, or government facilities. 4. Confirmation that proposed inspectors possess current Qualified Elevator Inspector (QEI) certification and identification of the certifying organization. 5. Ability to perform inspections at Government facilities located in Folsom, California and Jamestown, California. 6. Any experience performing inspections in accordance with ASME A17.1, A17.2, A17.3, and QEI-1 standards.  Responses are due: Thursday, December 3, 2026 at 10:00am PT Submit responses to: margaret_jones@ios.doi.gov  This notice is for market research purposes only and shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract.
